args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

Truncate the source report name with enough reserved space so that appending ' (copy)' never exceeds MAX_NAME_LENGTH, preventing truncation ellipsis from cutting off the copy suffix.

label: bug
file: src/api/reports.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Duplicating a report appends ' (copy)' after truncating the source name, causing the final name to exceed MAX_NAME_LENGTH and get cut off with '...'. We need to reserve space for the suffix during name truncation.
